description:
This diagram illustrates the structure of the High Resolution Water and Snow Ice (HR_WSI) Water products portfolio, categorising its components hierarchically. The top-level "HR_WSI Water products portfolio" branches into two main product groups: "HR Water Layer (HRWL) 2021" and "Water Cover Duration (WCD), yearly 2017-2021".

The "HR Water Layer (HRWL) 2021" group is further divided into:
- **Main Products:**
    - HR Water Layer (HRWL) 2021, 10m resolution, WGS84/UTM Coordinate Reference System (CRS).
    - Water Presence Index (WPI) 2021, 10m resolution, ETRS89 LAEA CRS.
    - HR Water Layer (HRWL) Confidence Layer (WCL) 2021, 10m resolution, LAEA CRS.
- **Derived Products:**
    - HR Water Layer (HRWL) 2021, 10m resolution, LAEA CRS.
    - HR Water Layer (HRWL) 2021, 100m resolution, LAEA CRS.
- **Auxiliary Data:**
    - Rolling Archive (WLRA) 2009-2021, binary water masks, 10m resolution, LAEA CRS.

The "Water Cover Duration (WCD), yearly 2017-2021" group is divided into:
- **Main Products:**
    - Water Cover Duration (WSD), 10m resolution, WGS84/UTM CRS.
- **Derived Products:**
    - Water Cover Duration (WSC), 10m resolution, LAEA CRS.
    - Water Cover Duration (WCD), 100m resolution, LAEA CRS.
